reason: Re-opened packet.js tao 6 and the raw wikisource revision 2019760 (2021-03-10): chapter 6 (成象) has 谷，養也。人能養神則不死也。神，謂五臟之神也 on 谷神不死 and 玄，天也，於人為鼻。牝，地也，於人為口 on 是謂玄牝, each found once. Base lines 谷神不死，是謂玄牝 match Legge's key verse. Plain sense is context only (the verse opens the chapter, which then names a gate called the root), no four-word run of the key. verse.js ok (Tao Te Ching 6, at [5], 15 words); entry-check ok, no errors or warns.
